name: moon-moth
description: Small moon helper that reports affected projects and runs their typecheck, lint, and test tasks. Cross-runtime (Claude Code + Codex).

interface.shortDescription: Report and verify affected moon projects
interface.longDescription: Moon Moth is a small helper for moon monorepos. It reports projects affected by an existing diff and runs their typecheck, lint, and test tasks through moon without adding workflow state or orchestration.
defaultPrompt: Use Moon Moth to report the moon projects affected by my current changes.
Use Moon Moth to verify my changes by running affected typecheck, lint, and test.
